{"notes": "Visit 2 (left 3:30).

Sofia: At 3:00 she said she was laying a rounder bridge from the end of the back up into Hana's tail, and that Hana's tail stays put. She also checked on Omar and Jack. This is good follow-through on the notch concern from visit 1, with clear communication. On the table the back arc now runs dark and connected to about x=22.5, y=9, but the pale tail starts right at that end and is not yet linked. I can't tell whether the bridge is finished or still has a gap, and I didn't see her place pieces, so I can't credit her with the arc itself. To check next visit.

Hana: Her top tail is placed (pale, x~22.7-28.5, y~5-9.7). That matches her earlier plan to build it separately and join it. She was quiet this visit, so I have no new leadership evidence. Her tail is only worth credit once the join holds.

Omar: First direct evidence. At 3:15 he gave a clear status (belly about ten dominoes from the lower notch), and he sequenced Jack to start the bottom tail and promised to shout when the belly lands. This is good collaboration and some leadership. The belly is dark and connected to about x=18, y=13.4, so his estimate looks roughly right. I don't know who placed the dominoes.

Jack: Still no direct evidence. Omar named him for the bottom tail, but no tail pieces exist at the lower right yet. I won't rate him on that. Next visit I need to see whether he started on Omar's cue.

Watch next: whether the back-to-tail join holds, whether the belly reaches the lower notch, whether the bottom tail starts, and how much time is left."}
